Statement [8.26.26] | Congresswoman Haley Stevens Skip to main content Phone:  (202)225-8171 Email Me Address:  2411 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515 Statement [8.26.26] August 26, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. – Today, the office of Haley Stevens issued the following statement:  “Today, Congresswoman Haley Stevens is thrilled to announce her engagement to longtime friend, attorney, and Huntington Woods resident Jason Turkish. “Haley and Jason share a deep love of family, community, and long conversations that have only gotten better over the years. Jason, who is legally blind, has devoted his career as an attorney to advocating for the rights of people with disabilities, from the courtroom to Capitol Hill. It was along the path of that work that Haley and Jason first met, brought together by a shared commitment to giving a voice to those too often unheard. “What began as a friendship grew into a partnership grounded in shared values, plenty of laughter, and a deep love for the community they call home. “They are overjoyed to begin planning their life together, surrounded by the family and friends they love in Oakland County, Michigan.” ###

STATEMENT: Haley Stevens Condemns Socialism | Congresswoman Haley Stevens Skip to main content Phone:  (202)225-8171 Email Me Address:  2411 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515 STATEMENT: Haley Stevens Condemns Socialism September 1, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. – In response to today’s vote on Condemning and Denouncing the Horrors of Socialism, Michigan Congresswoman Haley Stevens issued the following statement: “I am not a socialist, and I do not support socialism. I’m a Michigan Democrat who believes in capitalism, democracy, making sure billionaires pay their fair share of taxes, and standing with unions in the fight for workers’ rights. “This is a cynical, Republican-forced vote designed to present a false choice: that standing up for voting rights means embracing socialism. It doesn’t. “We can build things in Michigan, create good-paying union jobs, grow American manufacturing, and defend every citizen’s right to vote. “That’s the Michigan I believe in.”   ###

Congress must pass my No Tariffs on Groceries Act now to stop Trump’s reckless trade policies from making grocery bills more expensive.”   ### Issues : How We’re Responding to the Trump Administration

Listen to what Michiganders are hearing about Rep. Haley Stevens’ thoughts on the Iran war: This administration has got to be a lot more transparent. For goodness sakes, they start this war, they do it without the approval of Congress. They didn't even brief us. We're still not getting access to the information we need, and it doesn't seem to be a plan. Oh mission accomplished. Oh, we've got a ceasefire with Iran. Oops, 3 days later now we don't, you know, we're losing troops, which is so tragic. We're paying for this war as Michiganders, you know, as costs continue to go up. As, you know, the Trump administration is…giving the billionaires a tax cut, but slashing healthcare and food assistance for us, you know, a $70 billion slush fund to ICE. You know, are we safer? So I want to know what the plan is. I want to, I want this war to end. I have been voting every single time to get us to that place. Stevens has continuously called out Trump’s illegal war and its impact on Michigan families. She proudly supported the Iran War Powers Resolution , calling on Donald Trump to end his illegal attacks, and has repeatedly voted to curtail his reach. Rep. Stevens has remained focused on the affordability crisis the Iran war is causing for Michigan families, fighting to install real-time gas price trackers in Congress.
